# Tide clock

Shows the next high tide. See the [setup guide](https://github.com/example/tides/blob/v1.2.0/samples/clock/docs/setup.md), the
[API notes](https://github.com/example/tides/blob/v1.2.0/samples/api/README.md#clock), the [issue list](https://github.com/example/tides/blob/v1.2.0/issues) and the
[project site](https://example.com/tides).

![Screenshot of the clock](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/example/tides/v1.2.0/samples/clock/images/clock.png)

<img src="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/example/tides/v1.2.0/samples/clock/images/dial.svg" alt="Dial"> and [the FAQ](https://github.com/example/tides/blob/v1.2.0/samples/clock/docs/faq.md).

## Run it

```bash
# Run it
cat docs/setup.md   # [not a link](docs/setup.md)
```

Use `[text](docs/inline.md)` syntax for links. Jump to [the details](#details).

### Details

Reference-style links work too: see [the changelog][log] and write to
